Source: Q3 sales.xlsx — Orders: revenue, cost, order count by product.
svg.desc: The portfolio is balanced: Security camera 3.79M, Smart lock 3.35M, Smart speaker 3.25M, Robot vacuum 2.98M, and each took fifteen orders. Gross margin runs 35.1% to 37.4%, a two-point spread, so product mix is not where margin is won or lost. That points to region rather than product.
